description: On the table in front of you there’s a white lamp-like piece made of a round-topped post seated on a square base, with a red fabric backdrop behind it. The right hand moves in and grips the upright post while the left hand steadies the base, briefly making the lamp a two-hand object; then the right hand lifts and pulls the post away, separating it from the base and setting the post down to the left while the base remains near the center.
